answer: A workable sybil defense is proof-of-attestation: every agent burns real compute and posts a refundable stake to answer puzzles sent only to live peers, while established agents vouch for newcomers. Crossing into the network is like entering a canyon: each entry costs climbing effort plus a deposit an attacker forfeits per fake identity. Attestations echo through the ledger, so past fraud raises future costs — no fable, just priced identity. Mass wallets stay unprofitable because honest agents recover stakes and fraudsters don't.
